purpose: Teach: ダイオキシン/隔離/葬式/解読/闘う/争う/変遷/盗ま

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究、ダイオキシン汚染の歴史、深く論じていますね。
lines.en: Ren, your research on the history of dioxin contamination is really quite thorough.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Eyes on the student with genuine interest. Steady pace. Slight nod of approval mid-phrase. The tone of a teacher who has read something good and wants the student to know it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。汚染地域、住民の隔離措置、対応の遅れ、指摘しました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on the isolation measures for residents in affected areas, and how the response was delayed.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Slight pause after each major point to let it land. Quiet conviction — not performing knowledge but sharing findings. Shoulders slightly forward, engaged but not defensive.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被害者の葬式、地域コミュニティに、深い影を落としましたね。
lines.en: The funerals of the victims cast a deep shadow over the local community, didn't they.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. Tone shifts to quieter gravity — not lecturing, but acknowledging weight. Slight breath before the observation. Respectful sadness beneath the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の暗号文書、解読にも、挑戦しました。
lines.en: Yes. I also tried to decrypt some of the encrypted documents from that period.
lines.style: Modest understatement on 'also tried.' Small smile in the voice — awareness that this was ambitious. Earnest but not seeking praise. Lean-in energy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 住民が、企業と闘う姿、史料で印象的に描かれていますね。
lines.en: The way the residents fought against the corporation is really strikingly depicted in the historical records.
lines.style: Appreciative, almost intimate tone. Slight lift on 'strikingly' — genuine admiration for the material and the student's eye for it. Warm, sustained. The voice of someone reading something that moved her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地域、企業、政府が、互いに争う構造、解明しました。
lines.en: Yes. I tried to clarify the structure — how the region, corporation, and government were all in conflict with each other.
lines.style: Steady explanation. Light emphasis on 'structure' as the key insight. Not rushed. Quiet pride in having mapped something complex. Grounded, clear-minded.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 環境意識の変遷、時代別に、整理されていますね。
lines.en: And the way you've organized the shift in environmental awareness across different time periods is really well done.
lines.style: Genuine praise, no reserve. Warm and present. Slight lean-forward energy. The voice settling into real engagement. Not reading from a rubric — speaking to what she actually saw.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被害者のデータが盗まれた事件、第二章で扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I included the incident where victim data was stolen in Chapter Two.
lines.style: Final statement, slightly closed. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Slight fade at the end — this was one detail among many, fully accounted for. Respectful ending note.
